title: 跨平台加密存储与密钥生命周期

key_backends: Windows current-user DPAPI wrapping a random 32-byte key
POSIX owner-only random key file outside the data directory
key_checks: parent directory not writable by others on POSIX; Windows parent ACL hardened
random namespace key protected by the active provider
rotation provider key location revalidated against the data directory
security_summary.aad: canonical JSON binds format, purpose, account/service domains, opaque account reference, revision and optional record_id
security_summary.nonce: 12 random bytes per seal; unique per operation
security_summary.account_reference: HKDF-separated HMAC-SHA256 pseudonym, stable across data-key rotation
security_summary.legacy: LA-DPAPI-1, THU-ACTION-1 and THU-TODOS-1 are recognized read-only and never rewritten automatically
security_summary.node_boundary: fixed actions, 2 MiB request and 1 MiB plaintext limits, minimal subprocess environment
security_summary.plaintext_fallback: none; missing key refuses production storage
security_summary.record_identity: new records bind record_id into AAD; copying a record to another record path fails with SECURE_RECORD_MISMATCH; legacy unbound records only in a legacy pointer
security_summary.rollback: explicit retired key files via THU_SECURE_RETIRED_KEY_FILES; previous records and namespace authenticated before pointer switch

full_offline_suite_linux.worktree: clean checkout of audit-fix commit a6b54bb

contracts.record_id_schema: optional record_id added to secure-storage-header-v1 with backward-compatible AAD omission

accepted_cases: different ciphertext and nonce on repeated sealing; same provider recovers plaintext
nonce, ciphertext, service domain and account domain tampering fail closed without partial plaintext
missing key, broad permissions, symlinks and reparse points are rejected
write, fsync and pointer-switch failures preserve the previous valid record or pointer
half-failed rotation leaves the old pointer/key readable; retry completes
rotation preserves the account reference and is readable after restart and rollback
record identity is bound to AAD; copying one record onto another fails with SECURE_RECORD_MISMATCH
rotation rejects a new key located inside the data directory
a restarted store can roll back with THU_SECURE_RETIRED_KEY_FILES; corrupt previous records are refused
health authenticates ciphertext, counts unreadable records and does not expose paths
first pointer failure reclaims empty orphan record directories on restart
cross-account, cross-purpose and cross-service reads are denied
concurrent writers cannot both advance the same revision
stored data and temporary files contain no synthetic plaintext
production entry refuses a missing key and does not import a test codec
header validates against JSON Schema Draft 2020-12
Windows DPAPI key creation/load, ACL rejection and legacy read pass on Windows CI
Windows key and record files are opened in binary mode; no newline translation corrupts ciphertext
private bridge subprocess returns one JSON response and keeps key paths out of payloads
legacy DPAPI format is recognized; cross-platform read returns a re-authentication error
limits: The cloud Linux host cannot run Windows DPAPI/ACL locally; those tests passed on the GitHub windows-2025 runner.
No anti-rollback claim: revision and record identity detect ordinary record replacement, not an attacker replacing both data and pointer.
No automatic cross-machine key migration or secure deletion.
The module is not yet wired to the existing session/action paths; 3.1/4.x must consume it before claiming end-to-end protection.
The release/packaging module 6.3 still owns the final runtime dependency manifest and lock; cryptography is now declared for the package dependency while 6.3 can adjust the lock.
rollback: Stop new writes, keep the previous records directory and key, set THU_SECURE_RETIRED_KEY_FILES to the previous key path(s), verify old records, then rollback() switches store.json back. No old ciphertext or key is deleted automatically.
next: P1 fixes and the 2026-11-17 re-audit are complete. Batch 2 stays accepted at 4519117 and is re-verified at 34c463d; batch 3 is ready. Do not start 3.1 in this 2.2 task; the next batch executor begins when assigned.
cross_module_requests: contracts/v0.2/storage-header.schema.json: additive optional record_id under secure-storage-header-v1; 1.1 owner review required before release.
pyproject.toml: cryptography==50.0.2 runtime dependency; 6.3 remains owner of the final lock and packaging layout.

fixes: SDDL owner/ACE parsing now accepts concrete SIDs as well as alias tokens, and normalises well-known principals before comparison; four synthetic-SDDL tests run on Linux and Windows.
A failed rotation discards the unpublished target directory it created; the active records directory is untouched.
Record reads use a single O_NOFOLLOW open plus fstat and a bounded loop instead of a stat/read sequence; symlinks and non-files are still rejected.
validate_key_separation and record identity checks unchanged.
reaudit.windows_note: The new SDDL tests are platform-independent; the existing real Windows DPAPI/ACL tests still exercise the runner path.
